scope: Create one right-side review candidate that leaves the repaired eye fixed, retains the already-reviewed main V26 upper C001 body while omitting its detached rail/sliver solids, adds a 0.30 mm eye-side relief to lower C001, and shortens lower C012/C013 only at their eye-side ends. Re-run exact eye collision checks against all 101 right-shell components.

allowed_actions: Copy frozen exact geometry into a new one-sided review document
Retain only the largest valid closed solid from the already-reviewed V26 upper C001 candidate
Subtract the fixed eye and a 0.30 mm shifted eye tool from lower C001
Shorten lower C012 and C013 at their eye-side ends using the numeric half-space contract
Run exact OCCT collision, validity, closure, component-count, bounds, and engagement checks
Write one FCStd review file, deterministic validation JSON, and checkpoint

Add, bridge, reconnect, or reposition any plank, rail, rib, flange, or support
Change ears, translucent panels, rear cassette, C006, or aluminum V0.5-M2
Mirror or integrate the proposal into production owners
Export STL, 3MF, G-code, slice, or authorize ASA printing
release_holds: V40 is one-sided review geometry only
